name: Gutenberg Photoblocks Gallery
author: wpcraftnet

sections.description:
Gutenberg Photoblocks Gallery is a clean and intuitive Gutenberg block plugin that allows WordPress users to easily create stunning photo galleries using the block editor. Perfect for photographers, bloggers, artists, small businesses, or anyone who wants to showcase visual content in a stylish, responsive layout.

With drag-and-drop image uploads, adjustable column layouts, spacing controls, and optional captions, WP PhotoBlocks helps you present your images exactly the way you want—right inside the native block editor.

No more clunky shortcodes or third-party interfaces—just fast, simple, and visually rich galleries built directly in Gutenberg.

Whether you’re building a portfolio, travel blog, or product showcase, Gutenberg Photoblocks Gallery gives you a simple, reliable, and elegant way to make your photos shine.

🔓 Free Features:

  • Build beautiful photo galleries directly within the native Gutenberg block editor.
  • Responsive grid layout with adjustable columns and spacing
  • Support for optional image captions
  • Lightweight design, optimized for fast loading and performance
  • Clean front-end output with minimal, efficient CSS
  • Built-in pagination to manage large image collections
  • Control how many images appear per page with “Images Per Page” setting
  • Choose from multiple image sizes: Full, Medium, Thumbnail, or define a custom size.

🔐 Pro Features:

  • All features available in the free version are included in the Pro version
  • Multiple gallery layouts: Lightbox, Carousel, and Masonry
  • Seamless infinite scrolling for continuous gallery browsing
  • Toggleable navigation arrows in both Lightbox and Carousel layouts
  • Thumbnail pagination in Lightbox for easy navigation
  • Minimal and efficient CSS for clean front-end rendering
  • Carousel layout supports autoplay and left/right navigation controls
  • Dot pagination included in the Carousel layout for a sleek user experience.

Usage

  1. Create or edit a post or page
  2. Open the Gutenberg Block Editor
  3. Click the “+” button and search for Photoblocks Gallery
  4. Add images from your media library or upload new ones
  5. Configure layout, image size, and other settings from the block sidebar
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation:

  1. Go to your WordPress Dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the photoblocks-gallery.zip file
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Extract the contents to /wp-content/plugins/photoblocks-gallery/
  3. Go to the WordPress admin panel and activate the plugin
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support the Classic Editor?

No. RK Photo Gallery Block is built specifically for the Gutenberg (Block) Editor.

Is it compatible with all themes?

Yes, the plugin works with any theme that supports Gutenberg blocks.

How can I access Pro features?

You will need to upgrade to the Pro version to unlock Carousel, Lightbox, and additional features.

Can I define custom image sizes?

Yes. The plugin allows selecting predefined sizes or setting a custom width and height.
